title: TruEphirE
tagline: Infrastructure to bridge data feeds from other providers onto Oasis Sapphire using TEE.
description:
Infrastructure to bridge data feeds from other data block chains and feeds (such as Chainlink and Flare) onto Oasis Sapphire using TEE.

Oasis Sapphire does not have data from Flare or Chainlink so we decided to build a way to make that data securely available.

Smart contract written in Soliditiy
TEE portion written in Python (could have been written in typescript)
how_its_made:
- smart contract reading Chainlink data from mainnet Ethereum and Flare RPC call to pull data into Oasis ROFL
- TEE calling contract and recording to Oasis Sapphire
